added.summary: Exposed Tier::Full hardware capability flags: rg32Renderable, highBindingSlots, rg11b10Renderable, depthClipControl, shaderF16, subgroup, multiDrawIndirectCount, and bindlessTextures.
Added 4 bpp compressed texture formats (Bc1, Bc4, Etc2Rgb8, EacR11), automatic metallic/roughness/AO (ORM) texture packing, and resident mip-tail streaming support.

Added Tier::Full subgroup WG=256 scans and reductions, FP16 compute SPD bloom, single-pass conservative SPD Hi-Z, balanced 2-stage meshlet culling, tile-classified 8 B/px VisBuffer resolve, native multi-draw indirect coalescing, native 1024-slot bindless opaque material table, Hillaire Sky-View LUT, compute histogram auto-exposure, single-pass compute pre-skinning, and automatic native pipeline cache persistence.

fixed.summary: Replaced the 148 B/px VisBuffer attribute buffer with a direct-pull 8 B/px tile-classified VisBuffer (eliminating high-resolution overflow) and wired analytic normal derivatives into specular AA and weathering normal bend.

Fixed FSR 3.1 exposure reset, motion jitter alignment, native sRGB dithering, contact shadow UV alignment, motion blur soft-Z and bent-normal blur, grass shadow depth clipping, and restored opaque Early-Z / Hi-Z by disabling alpha-to-coverage on non-discarding pipelines.
